attribution: Index maintenance coupled with per-5000-row commit/journal behavior is dominant: removing the active secondary index reduces total wall time from 118.893s to 12.508s and commit time from 92.143s to 0.268s. Ordered reads and Python insert execution are secondary.
exact_next_authorization_required: Fixture-qualify exactly one byte-preserving repair targeted at the isolated index-maintenance plus commit/journal cost, with byte identity first and a 270-second model before any real snapshot.
real_run_reconciliation: Real partial final stage was 235.210s for 545000 token rows versus local reference 118.893s for 588439 rows. Local commit latency is highly variable (max 9.847s); host/storage contention remains a plausible but unproven multiplier.
recommended_next_repair_target: A single byte-preserving index-maintenance/commit-journal repair candidate. Do not omit or rebuild indexes without proving exact final bytes first.
